description: Per the spike's findings: add "ja" to app.json supported_languages, localize the network permission description and any store listing text if Even Hub supports it, and make sure review requirements (exit dialog, recording indicator wording) are met in Japanese.

comments.text: app.json supported_languages now [en, ja]; evenhub pack accepts it (CLI enum: en de fr es it zh ja ko). The permission desc is a single string (max 300 chars) with no localized variant, so it stays English. Review items hold in Japanese: exit is the system dialog (shutDownPageContainer(1)), and the glasses recording indicator stays 'REC' in every locale, matching the consent text.

title: Even Hub manifest and store metadata for Japanese
